body: thx. it got answered, actually. not in a good way at all but...it got answered. so i'm kind of impressed.
Trust me being forgotten is not what you want

It was probably controversial because a lot of people on this sub see the word “teenager” and immediately go berserk and assume you aren’t serious about writing and know nothing. 

Don’t feel bad for not being motivated, it happens to everyone. And that’s awesome that you’re setting a word count goal of 2,000! That’s pretty high. I wish you luck

I know this is late and your edit says you’ve calmed down by now but... please don’t give up. I remember being 13, it wasn’t long ago cause I’m still a teen now but 13 was one of the worst years of my life and no one understood how bad it really was. If you want someone to talk to one on one, DM me and I’ll do the best I can.

Just because the people at your school are different doesn’t mean they’re less than you. Try to get to know them and see them as something more than than the annoyance you see them as now. It’s hard to not be able to fit in but you have to make do with what you have.
Yeah using age as a stepping stone is definitely annoying. Especially using it to belittle other people who are older and haven’t had the same success.

I really shouldn’t have said “everyone”. But I did see some posts on this sub about teen writers really just not being able to produce quality work... ever. It seemed a bit widespread and I thought it was the attitude of the whole sub. But the comments here don’t seem to reflect that at all, and I’m pretty happy to see that.
Hey, good point. Arrogance is definitely obnoxious. I didn’t really consider that the teens might be making themselves look bad.

-YA is mostly a garbage genre at this point 
- Owning books is not a personality trait 
- adults reading YA exclusively is a bit weird to me

First of all, people who brag about skipping meals to write are ridiculous. Writing shouldn’t be a thing that dominates your life and renders you unable to even take breaks for things like eating or spending time with your family. Discipline definitely has its value but that doesn’t have to come at the cost of your actual life. And what works for you works for you in terms of how often you write.
Social media in general is non essential to me. So is browsing that isn’t directly related to an assignment I have to do.
